verdict.rationale: Image transformation is a fair question for Firebase, which includes Cloud Storage, but the evidence documents no image resizing or transformation capability. The only related items are Cloud Functions with Cloud Storage triggers, which are building blocks for writing your own pipeline, and a generic mention of Firebase Extensions that names no image-resizing extension. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve resized or transformed images from storage without running my own image pipeline
